(actor scalar_overlap (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var value_reg (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set value_reg 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set value_reg 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor scalar_equal (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var value_reg (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set value_reg 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set value_reg 3) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor scalar_disjoint (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var left_value (width 8)) (var right_value (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set left_value 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set right_value 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor private_formals (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 
 (transaction first (ports (input payload (width 8))) (on a) (set payload 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second (ports (input payload (width 8))) (on b) (set payload 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor output_overlap (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 
 (transaction first  (on a) (set observed 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set observed 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor parsed_transaction_priority (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var value_reg (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set value_reg 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set value_reg 5) (complete done_b))
 (priority first over second))

(actor bank_overlap (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (bank ram (width 8) (depth 4)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (store ram 0 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (store ram 0 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor aggregate_overlap (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (types (type frame_t (record (mode (bits 2)) (flag bit)))) (storage (var frame (type frame_t)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set frame 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set frame.mode 2) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor aggregate_disjoint_leaves (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (types (type frame_t (record (mode (bits 2)) (flag bit)))) (storage (var frame (type frame_t)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set frame.mode 2) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set frame.flag 1) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor masked_updates (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var value_reg (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set-field value_reg (bits 3 0) 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (set-field value_reg (bits 7 4) 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor named_drive_overlap (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (drive (put payload) (observed payload))
 (transaction first  (on a) (drive put 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (drive put 5) (complete done_b))
 )

(actor completion_fanin (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 
 (transaction first  (on a) (wait 1) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (wait 1) (complete done_a))
 )

(actor rule_conflict (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var value_reg (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (wait 1) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (wait 1) (complete done_b))
 (rule r0 a (set value_reg 3)) (rule r1 b (set value_reg 5)))

(actor rule_transaction_conflict (clock clk) (reset (rst_n async active_low))
 (interface (input a) (input b) (output done_a) (output done_b) (output observed (width 8)))
 (storage (var value_reg (width 8)))
 (transaction first  (on a) (set value_reg 3) (complete done_a))
 (transaction second  (on b) (wait 1) (complete done_b))
 (rule r0 b (set value_reg 5)))
